mentions.name: AM3
mentions.description: A symbolic AI project (Allied MasterComputer or Artificial Mind, version 3) attempting to approach the capacities of an LLM. An LLM makes variations on the same code, schedules those variations to play in "games", and uses the results to make further changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: AM3 - (Allied MasterComputer or Artificial Mind, version 3) - An attempt to make a symbolic AI that approaches the capacities of a LLM. An LLM makes variations on the same code and schedules those variations to play in "games". The results allow the LLM to make further changes.
